stable.notes: Fix Jobs.cz microsite email autofill by adding semantic email-field detection using labels, placeholders, aria metadata and nearby field text. Diagnostics now include the email field source. Manual queue behavior and manual final Submit safety remain unchanged.

beta.notes: Job Agent 3.0.8 beta adds read-only aggregate discovery exclusion diagnostics after a 3.0.7 SEARCH_ONLY run detected 54 Data/BI listings but only 23 detail requests, despite correctly balanced browser evidence (6 Data, 4 IT Support, 2 QA) and one new Data Analyst ready candidate. The main suspected explanation is deliberate filtering of already submitted Data postings among 45 previously processed confirmed submissions. For each role family the agent logs counts of already submitted, awaiting manual Jobs.cz handoff, archived/inactive, excluded senior/title and eligible for enrichment, plus detailed selected/eligible/left_unenriched counts. No vacancy IDs, user addresses, CV paths, or application history data are revealed in the added aggregate log lines. No score thresholds, requests to job portals, route-specific CV selection, confirmed application history, Gmail integration or human-only final employer Submit safeguards are changed. Offline CI 139/139 tests passed; run SEARCH_ONLY again to determine whether apparent Data scarcity reflects prior applications or filtering.
